id: title:cat-ph:link issues to existing external issues via the api

review.posthog_relevance: Adds backend implementation for linking external error-tracking issues to PostHog and searching for them, including idempotent linking and request/response serialization.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F3.H6 adds the backend implementation for creating an external reference and linking an issue. P1.F4.H5 and P1.F4.H5 show the removal of the old URL-returning behavior and the addition of the link_issue and search_issues actions with their respective request/response serializers. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
